content: MobileRead 'Introduction to plugins' thread + manual: install via Preferences>Plugins>Get new plugins (catalog) or Load plugin from file / calibre-customize -a for a manual zip; installer prompts which toolbar/menu to add the action to; restart is mandatory after install ('Ctrl+R' shortcut mentioned); zip must not be touched by antivirus/download managers (unzip corrupts it). No Windows-specific install deviation documented — procedure is presented as platform-agnostic; Windows-specific pain in the wild is more about antivirus false-positives on plugin zips and %APPDATA% config paths than the install flow itself.
